statement: A diagonal primary Hopf family with one contraction multiplier vanishing to positive order and the other tending to a nonzero contraction admits no proper analytic completion over the disc, even after finite base change and allowing singular or nonreduced completions.
depends_on: Exact bivector automorphy; quantitative Rouche theorem; Grauert proper direct-image coherence; analytic resolution preserving the smooth locus
R_items_and_Leads_used: Actual auxiliary Hopf multiplier marking independently checked; no Lead assumed
notes: Root and limits_ab independently passed the full proof. Accumulating anticanonical resonances contradict the coherent direct-image exact sequence. Oda1978 Section13 instead has both contraction eigenvalues tending to zero. This excludes the specified unblown Hopf replacement of the Kato collar and alone does not exclude arbitrary completions of the actual two-torus family; the actual global noncompletion is proved in B.4.33.
